Pecanac et al. 2025 directly reported a ~40 nm icosahedral shell composed of 240 subunits, resolved at 3.4 Å (PDB 9I8E / EMD-52715). The WT shell has an open 5-fold pore of ~10 Å, a nearly closed 6-fold pore, and an additional triangular pore. Heterologous CyanoPOX- and PTDH-mFMO-loaded WT preparations are not treated as separate assemblies because no distinct global shell architecture was demonstrated.
